findings.message: The sidebar is now 190 Dp wide (Min/MaxSize Width 190), but the test asserts a.Dx() == 210. The test will fail unless the allocated width differs by exactly 20, which is unlikely.
findings.suggestion: Assert 190, or derive the expected width from the style constant.

finding.title: Search field height 16 with padding clips text
finding.message: The search field has a max height of 16 with 4 Dp vertical padding, leaving about 8 Dp for text at 13 pt. The text will clip, and the test's 32 Dp bound does not catch it. Similarly, tool action buttons use MaxSize height 16 with 6 Dp padding, and the note title button is capped at 16 Dp.
finding.suggestion: Set the field height to about 28 Dp (as the README states) and include padding in the sizing, or drop the MaxSize cap.
finding.evidence: MinSize: ui.Some(ui.Size{Height: 16}), MaxSize: ui.Some(ui.Size{Height: 16}), Padding: ui.Some(ui.Insets{Left: 8, Right: 8, Top: 4, Bottom: 4})
